messages:
elyse: FYI found a tenant-facing regression: short requests from older agents are being pulled into larger coalesce windows. p99 latency up.
sam: Minimal repro?
elyse: Agent without new handshake header + short payload -> server sees no deadline_hint and batches into default 120ms window.
ravi: Missing handshake also means we skip slot pinning which then causes odd headroom calculations under load.
marta: Immediate ideas: (1) synthesize a conservative deadline at the ingress, (2) mark synthesized requests as "no_kv_reserve", (3) normalize fields into a thin canonical layer so downstream code doesn't need feature-branching.
sam: Agree on normalization layer. Keep it tiny and inline to avoid perf hit. Fields: canonical_deadline_hint, kv_reserved(bool), handshake_version.
elyse: For synthesis value propose: min(tenant_min_slo, 60ms). Avoid being too permissive.
ravi: When kv_reserved=false we reduce cache effectiveness, but that's safer than overcommit. Document the trade-off and measure cache-miss delta.
marta: Telemetry: emit `enqueue.normalized`, `enqueue.synth_deadline`, `enqueue.kv_no_reserve` and latency splits by handshake_version.
elyse: Rollout: start read-only (metrics only) for 24h, then enable synth per-tenant via gradual ramp if needed. Auto-toggle microwindow policy for tenants with >5% synthesized over 30m.
sam: Add response header `x-rw-compat:synth_deadline` so client teams can detect synthesized behavior.
ravi: Tests: unit for normalizer, perf integration that mixes 10% legacy agents at 40k rps to validate no headroom overcommit.
marta: Important: do not change required Enqueue proto fields. Use optional headers or server-side synth only. Hosted agents must remain compatible.
elyse: infra-bot: queued job eng-runtime/compatibility-smoke (unit + light perf). :robot_face:
elyse: I'll open a PR with the normalize middleware and telemetry. Assign reviewers.
sam: I'll add the microwindow config and tenant auto-toggle hook.
ravi: I'll write the KV headroom stress tests.
marta: I'll draft the playbook and alerts for synthesized fraction spikes.
